_source.title: 获取指定名称的分类的分类索引
_source.remarks.text.0: 分类索引内包含分类的 UUID，具体可查阅 {@link ILIB_ClassificationIndex}
_source.example.text.1: 2. 创建两级测试分类（复用模块库，ELIB_LibraryType.CBB = '1'）
_source.example.text.3: 4. 按一级 + 二级名称查索引（secondaryClassificationName 可选）
_source.example.text.4: 5. 清理测试分类（查询类需要清理）
_source.deprecated: since EDA v3.2; dropped EDA v3.3

title: Get the classification index of the classification with the specified name
remarks.text.0: The classification index contains the UUID of the classification. For details, refer to {@link ILIB_ClassificationIndex}
deprecated: since EDA v3.2; dropped EDA v3.3
